description: Halvor has never done a hand’s turn, but when a skipper asks if he’d like to see foreign lands, he’s up out of the ashes in a flash. A storm drives the ship to a strange coast, where three princesses sit captive in three castles, each with its own troll.
summary: Lazy Halvor kills three trolls and wins a princess, then loses her by breaking his promise and must find his way to Soria Moria Castle.
